theme.title: Across the NBA
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: Bars: three single-game scoring records set before. How many points did Kobe Bryant score against Toronto in January 2006?
questions.note: 81, second only to Wilt's 100, in a game the Lakers trailed by 14 at halftime.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: On January 22, 2006, Bryant scored a career-high 81 points

funFacts.text: The Lakers trailed Toronto by 14 points at halftime before Kobe took over.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Lakers trailed 63–49 at halftime

funFacts.text: By the time of this game, Bryant had already become the youngest player to win three championships.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: At age 23, he became the youngest player to win three championships

funFacts.text: He played 42 minutes and knocked down seven threes during the explosion.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Bryant play 42 minutes, shooting 28-of-46 from the field, including 7-of-13 on three-pointers

questions.prompt: The 1993–94 Rockets opened with 15 straight wins. How many straight games did Seattle win to start its 1993–94 season?
questions.note: Ten. Seattle reached 26–3 and finished with the NBA's best record.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: winning their first ten games of the regular season

funFacts.text: Seattle reached a 26–3 record early in that spectacular regular season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The team got off to a 26–3 start to the season

funFacts.text: By the All-Star break, the Sonics were 35–10 and led the entire NBA.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: held a league-best 35–10 record at the All-Star break

funFacts.text: Seattle finished the season by winning 17 of its last 19 games.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: won 17 of their final 19 games of the season

questions.prompt: When Jokić and Murray made triple-double history in the 2023 Finals, how many rebounds did Jokić grab?
questions.context: Denver Nuggets · Finals Game 3 vs Miami
questions.note: 21 rebounds in a 32-point triple-double as Denver took back the series lead.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: 32 points, 21 rebounds, and 10 assists

funFacts.text: Jamal Murray made it a historic pair of high-scoring triple-doubles with 34 points of his own.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: game-high 34 points

funFacts.text: Denver dominated the rebounding battle, beating Miami 58 to 33 on the glass.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: boards (58 to 33)

funFacts.text: Christian Braun's breakout cameo delivered 15 points on exceptionally efficient shooting.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Christian Braun scored 15 points

questions.prompt: Bars: other contenders' lead playmakers. How many assists per game did Kings point guard Mike Bibby average in 2001–02?
questions.note: 5.0, barely above Chris Webber's 4.8: Sacramento's offense ran through its passing big men.

funFacts.text: Bibby started all eighty regular-season games he played.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Mike Bibby | 80 | 80 | 33.2

funFacts.text: He averaged 20.3 points in the ensuing playoffs.
His postseason three-point accuracy was 42.4 percent.

questions.prompt: In Boston's 2008 title-clinching rout of Kobe's Lakers, how many points did Ray Allen and Kevin Garnett score together?
questions.context: Allen + Garnett · Celtics vs Lakers · 2008 Finals
questions.note: 52 points: Ray Allen and Kevin Garnett scored exactly 26 each.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Pts: Allen, Garnett 26 each
source.derivation: Ray Allen 26 + Kevin Garnett 26 = 52 combined points.

funFacts.text: Ray Allen tied a Finals record for threes.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Ray Allen hit seven three-pointers to tie what was then the Finals record

funFacts.text: Boston's defense set a steals record in the championship clincher.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: set a Finals record with 18 steals

funFacts.text: Garnett celebrated with his famous postgame speech.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Kevin Garnett delivered his famous "anything is possible" speech
